checks.text: The page shows the heading "Regex Tester" and the tab labels "Test" and "History".
On the Test tab, typing `hello` in the field labelled "Pattern" and `hello world` in the field labelled "Sample text" shows a match list containing the text "hello" and the line "Matches: 1".
With Pattern `(\d+)` and Sample text `a1 b22 c333`, the match list contains three items showing "1", "22" and "333", and the line "Matches: 3".
With Pattern `(\d+)` and Sample text `a1 b22 c333`, the match list item for "22" shows the capture group text "Group 1: 22".
With Pattern `(\d+)` and Sample text `a1 b22 c333`, clicking the button "Copy result" copies the text "1\n22\n333" to the clipboard and shows the message "Copied".
With Pattern `(\d+)` and Sample text `a1 b22 c333`, clicking the button "Save pattern" adds a row to the History tab containing "(\d+)" and "3".
On the History tab, with the saved pattern "(\d+)" present, clicking the button "Delete (\d+)" removes that row and the History tab shows "No saved patterns".
With Pattern `(\d+)` and Sample text `a1 b22 c333`, checking the checkbox labelled "Case insensitive" and then changing Sample text to `A1 B22 C333` still shows "Matches: 3".
Reload keeps the saved pattern "(\d+)" in the History tab and the current Pattern field value "(\d+)".
